nom: Origins Ginzing SPF 40 Energy-Boosting Tinted Moisturizer

segments.dry: The reviewer who specifically describes her skin as dry says the moisturizer felt hydrating without being overly heavy.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination or oily/dry combination skin report the moisturizer generally hydrates well without looking shiny, though one notes the oilier areas of her face looked a little patchy with the tint.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are mixed: several, including one whose skin usually breaks out from SPF moisturizers, say it's lightweight, non-greasy and doesn't irritate or break them out, while one long-time sensitive-skin user of the discontinued SPF15 version says the current SPF40 formula feels too heavy and leaves a greasy, waxy look on her skin.
segments.mature: The two reviewers who mention aging or mature skin, including one who is 54 with fine lines and wrinkles, report the tint smooths and conceals the look of fine lines and sun spots.

concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers, including one who is 54, say the tint smooths and conceals the look of fine lines and wrinkles; one reviewer instead reports the finish draws attention to wrinkles and enlarged pores in natural light or photos and doesn't recommend it for those concerns.
concerns.dehydration: The majority of reviewers describe the formula as hydrating, leaving skin feeling moisturized, soft and dewy through the day; a handful of others, including one with melanated skin who finds the white cast also feels drying, instead report the product dries out their skin or isn't moisturizing enough on its own, leaving a cakey surface unless layered over other moisturizers.
concerns.redness: Reviewers dealing with redness, including one using the product on a partner with rosacea, report the tint visibly hides or reduces the look of redness around the nose, cheeks and general complexion without irritating the skin.
concerns.spots: The two reviewers who mention sun damage or dark spots say the tint helps blend and conceal them for a more even-looking complexion.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed for acne-prone skin: some, including one whose skin usually breaks out from SPF moisturizers, say this one causes no breakouts and even covers acne scars; others report it caused new breakouts in areas they don't normally break out, emphasized the texture of active acne, or triggered pimples almost instantly when worn while sweating.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers, including one with oily/dry combination skin, describe the finish as matte to natural rather than greasy or shiny; a few others report it feels greasy by the end of the day, gets oily after a few hours, or looks a little patchy over their oilier areas.

aspects.libelle: Shade can turn orange on fair skin
Leaves white cast on deeper skin
Fans miss the discontinued SPF 15 formula
Lightweight and non-greasy for most users
Feels thick or heavy to some
Recent packaging downsized, feels like a sample

extraits.titre: Leaves an ashy look on darker skin tones
extraits.texte: I bought the SPF30 and was so happy with it not leaving my face white after application. Just was glowing everyday. Then a year later they took away the 30 in the stores and now only have the tinted 40 which leaves a white caste on my face that lasts for a good couple hours even after rubbing it in well. I would love more sun protection and I like that it's not scented but why make this tinted if it doesn't do what was intended? I took a pic but it's a pic hard to tell on camera, in person it's a pretty big difference

extraits.titre: Not a replacement for the spf 15 version
extraits.texte: I used the spf 15 version of this product since it first came out, it was my daily holy grail product that made my face look just the right amount of glowy and evened out without being "makeup". I liked that it was weightless, moisturizing and the coverage was sheer enough to not have to be precise with application. I have sensitive skin and I've never had a tint or bb cream or anything feel so good on my skin. This spf 40 version? Nope. Hate it. It gives me a greasy pallor and is too heavy on my skin. Instead of glowy it gives wax statue. I wish they would bring back the old spf 15 version. I've tried actually dozens of different tinted moisturizers since they discontinued it (and I ran out of the stash I bought up and stored in my fridge as soon as I found out!) and I haven't liked anything. I wear spf separately on my face I don't need it in my makeup making it terrible.

This really took me by surprise. Most spf moisturizers break my very sensitive and acne prone skin out, but I've had no issues at all with this product. What's even better is the light tint that is just enough for a no makeup look, and it goes so perfectly under makeup, I don't even need a primer. This is thick but absorbs well and after a minute or so dries all the way down with no tackiness or oily feeling. It leaves my skin feeling really soft and hydrated all day long. There is a citrus scent, but I have no issues with it causing irritation. This product was gifted to me for review purposes.

I absolutely love this product! I have never spent a lot on beauty products in my life but decided to with this tinted moisturizer. It is fabulous! It helped conceal fine lines and made my skin look so much better! Even my husband noticed and said he thought it made my face look so much smoother! I am 54 and have fine lines and wrinkles and this product helps so much!

extraits.titre: One of the Best Tinted Sunscreens I have Used
extraits.texte: This product is one of the best tinted sunscreens that I have ever used! For starters, I have a deeper skin tone. So a lot of the tinted sunscreens don't blend in well with my skin tone at all. But this Origins product is the best!! It rubs in smoothly and makes my skin feel hydrated. It's definitely lightweight and has a light fragrance. (I did receive this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes). But this is absolutely a product I would refill up on once I run out!

I used this tinted moisturizer in the morning for the past days, and I have actually seen much improvement in my skin! There is less redness around my nose and cheeks, and the formula wasn't irritating. However, I do have combination skin so some areas that were oily looked a little patchy but overall I honestly enjoyed using this and will continue to use it sparingly for days I want a clean coverage look. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I enjoyed the smell of this sunscreen, and it got the job done of protecting my skin in the heat! The tint looked great on me. After a while during the day, however, it felt greasy and gunky, and when washing or wiping it off, it would burn my eyes and under-eye area until fully washed off my face. If I ever sweat with this product on my face, pimples would appear almost instantly. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.
